verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document replication across nodes or zones for high availability, and it gives no formal consistency model. The closest items earn no credit under the partial-credit boundary: server-side namespace copies across regions are a one-off backup feature, not continuous HA replication, and using object storage for state is architecture, not a stated replication guarantee. The single note that writes appear in search results immediately is too thin to count as a documented consistency model.
